positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Embedded Devices, Software Development and +6 skills

positions.title: Metrology Technician
positions.description:
Perform verification, diagnostics, and calibration of measurement equipment in accordance with customer, ASME, ASTM, and manufacturer requirements, both in customer facilities and in lab in the following disciplines:

Electronics (RF, LF, Precision and DC)
Physical/Dimensional
Temperature
Torque
Flow
Pressure

positions.title: Applied Mathematician
positions.description:
Application of physical, mathematical, and data science principles to construct and maintain an ISO/IEC 17025:2017 compliant calculational framework for the estimation of measurement uncertainty across all calibration disciplines.

Application of the former to numerically determine instrumental specification requirements, limits, and capabilities. 

Application of the former to statistical quality control analysis to assist in the determination of relevant quantities of measure and their tolerances for the verification and calibration of production processes.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Learned and applied machine learning methods, Bayesian and Frequentists statistical modeling, and Python programming in conjunction with stellar evolution code frameworks for numerical modeling and parameter estimation in deep crustal heating models for low mass x-ray binary systems.

Learned and applied statistical methods to the reduction and analysis of photometric survey data from the Blanco DECam Southern Bulge Survey and KPNO WIYN 0.9m telescope, inclusive of CCD image reduction and calibration.

Took observational data using the WIYN 0.9m telescope.

positions.title: PASS Leader
positions.description: Provided supplementary instruction for both parts of Finite Mathematics broken up over two semesters. Mainted student rapport and confidentiality. Identified student needs and taught them accordingly. Prepared study materials, exam review, and group activity work. Proctored exams. Provided instructor feedback on what works for the students and where specifically they are struggling.

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description: Everything from organization of lab materials for P201/221-P202/221 sequence, lab setup and take down, crafting of instrumentation (metal/woodworking), and cataloging of instrumentation for introductory physics labs.
